documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited presented its financial and operational performance update for Q2 and H1 FY27. In H1 FY27, the company recorded revenue from operations of ₹4,403.5 crore with an EBITDA margin of 7.9% and a PAT margin of 5.3%. Operating cash flows turned positive at ₹136.7 crore during H1 FY27. Promoters announced that starting from FY27, they will not draw salaries, making all payouts solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows. Sky Gold & Diamonds Limited reported consolidated revenue of INR 2,013 crores for Q1 FY27, representing a 78% year-on-year growth.

guidance.claim: Following preferential allotment in FY24, the company had guided for ₹3,000 crore revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28.
guidance.quote: Following the preferential allotment from marquee investors in FY24, we guided for ₹3,000 Cr revenue, ~3% PAT margin, and cash-flow neutrality by FY27–28 (vs FY24 revenue of ₹1,745 Cr).

guidance.claim: Sky Gold maintains a revenue target of INR 8,100 crores for FY27.
guidance.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

guidance.claim: The company aspires to achieve revenue between INR 18,000 crores and INR 19,000 crores by FY30.
guidance.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our aspiration of INR8,100 crores by FY27 and INR18,000 crores to INR19,000 crores by FY30.

guidance.claim: Sky Gold expects its overall PAT margin to be close to 5%.
guidance.quote: And our overall PAT margin will be close to 5%.

guidance.claim: Management targets operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%.
guidance.quote: But our plan is that, overall, we are now targeting to have operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%, that we have also provided in our IP as well.

demand_outlook.claim: Participation in a London expo yielded a prospective order pipeline of INR 30 crores to INR 45 crores across U.K. and European markets.
demand_outlook.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The share of non-22 KT jewelry rose to 14% in Q1 FY27 driven by customer preference for lower Karatage jewelry.
demand_outlook.quote: First, the share of non-22 KT jewelry has increased from 10.5%in Q4FY26 to 14% in Q1 FY27 due to structural shift in customer preference towards lower Karatage jewelry.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its manufacturing footprint to 1,50,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,50,000 sq. ft.

capex_expansion.claim: The company established an office in Dubai.
Future capacity expansion post-2028 is expected to require capex of INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores under a leased model.
capex_expansion.quote: It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores, which will be just 20% to 25% of the PAT that we will generate at that point of time, since we have already built a world-class facility and we have already invested in the capacity and infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: Developing a new factory to expand capacity from 1.20 tons to 2.4 tons will take approximately 120 days.
capex_expansion.quote: So, it will take 120 days. We made this facility in 90 days where we are here now, and it will take 120 days to develop the factory to go to 1.10 tons to 2.4 tons and 100% it will take around INR80 crores to INR100 crores of capex when we will be at a PAT of, I think, INR600 crores, whatever the number going to come -and will approximately 15% or 20% of the PAT.

capex_expansion.claim: Sky Gold expanded its manufacturing footprint to 1,35,000 sq. ft.
capex_expansion.quote: Manufacturing footprint expanded to 1,35,000 sq. ft.

margins_costs.claim: An increased share of value-added products served as the main driver for gross margin expansion.
margins_costs.quote: Reflecting our strengthening merchandising capabilities, our Value-Added share of business has increased in the recent period serving as the primary driver for gross margin expansion.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated gross margin improved by 27 basis points sequentially to 9.3% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA reached INR 157 crores in Q1 FY27, representing a margin of 7.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to INR157 crores, to 7.8% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Operating PAT crossed INR 100 crores for the first time in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: Operating PAT for the quarter crossed the INR100 crores mark for the first time.

margins_costs.claim: The implementation of ERP helped reduce gold loss from 1.5% to 0.5%.
margins_costs.quote: We have implemented an ERP to monitor operational KPI’s, this has led to reduction of gold loss from 1.5% to a lean 0.5%.

margins_costs.claim: Management guides for 10-20 bps Y-o-Y improvement in PAT margins going forward.
margins_costs.quote: However, we guide for 10-20 bps improvement in PAT margins Y-o-Y as we continue investing in new geographies and high-growth categories.

orders_capacity.claim: Sky Gold is currently operating at approximately 60% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: So, again, we are at 60% utilization right now, and we have room of 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's existing production capacity is 1.2 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So, 1.2 tons is our capacity to produce, and we are 60% approx utilization in the last quarter.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will cease drawing salaries starting FY27, receiving payouts exclusively via dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

capital_allocation.claim: Promoters will transition to a zero-salary model beginning FY27, linking compensation strictly to dividends.
capital_allocation.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model. Going forward, promoter remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends, and dividends will be declared only from operating cash flow generated by the business.

capital_allocation.claim: Net debt at the end of Q1 FY27 stood at INR 540 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: Net debt level for this quarter is INR540 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening remain Sky Gold's primary capital allocation priorities.
capital_allocation.quote: Our first priority will always be debt reduction and balance sheet strengthening. Dividend distribution will follow only after these objectives have been appropriately addressed.

capital_allocation.claim: Operating cash flow turned positive at approximately INR 30 crores in Q1 FY27.
capital_allocation.quote: I am pleased to report that during quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self- sufficient business model.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sky Gold encountered a cyber/fraud incident involving INR 10.7 crores, of which INR 3.5 crores has been recovered.
risks_headwinds.quote: So, out of that, INR10.7 crores was the total amount involved, but such incidents have unfortunately become increasingly prevalent across many organizations which are listed on the BSE and NSE.

risks_headwinds.claim: Forward-looking business projections are subject to risks in the Indian and global economy, competition, and operational execution.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company’s future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cash flows, the Company’s market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

management_commitments.claim: Sky Gold promoters will stop taking salaries from FY27 and receive compensation exclusively through dividends from operating cash flows.
management_commitments.quote: In line with our cash-first philosophy and uncompromising governance standards, promoters will not draw salaries from FY27, all promoter payouts will be solely through dividends generated from operating cash flows.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters will adopt a zero-salary compensation model starting in FY27, with remuneration dependent entirely on dividends.
management_commitments.quote: Beginning FY27, we will adopt a zero-salary promoter compensation model. Going forward, promoter remuneration will be linked entirely to dividends, and dividends will be declared only from operating cash flow generated by the business.

management_commitments.claim: Promoters committed to purchasing the property themselves if the sale process is not completed within the stipulated timeframe.
management_commitments.quote: I would also like to reiterate a commitment that I have previously made to our investors. If the sale process were not completed within the stipulated timeframe, the promoters themselves would purchase this property.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%.
management_commitments.quote: But our plan is that, overall, we are now targeting to have operating cash flow to PAT conversion of close to 20%, that we have also provided in our IP as well.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
